name: NTT Berlin 1 Data Center
notes: Official NTT location page lists the Berlin 1 facility in Spandau with 11,700+ sq m of server space and 17.1 MW maximum IT load.

name: NTT Berlin 2 Data Center / Marienpark
notes: Official NTT pages place Berlin 2 at Lankwitzer Strasse 45-47 and state 24 MW maximum/initial IT capacity across buildings A and B.

name: VIRTUS Marienpark Campus
notes: VIRTUS Germany locations page says the Marienpark campus comprises BERLIN1 and BERLIN2 and four buildings totaling 62.6 MW IT load, set to go live in 2027; DCD reported the Berlin campus groundbreaking and 57.6 MW full build-out in May 2025.

name: Data Castle BER1 / in.grid Spandau
developer: DATA CASTLE GmbH / Data Center Group
notes: Data Center Group project page describes BER1 in Berlin Spandau with 40 MVA total capacity, 26 MW IT load, 10,000 sq m IT area, and completion/commissioning planned for end-2025; DCD/press release reported Data Castle as the new owner in 2023.

name: NorthC Berlin redevelopment data center
notes: NorthC announced entry into Berlin through redevelopment of an existing building, with 3 MW initial IT load and growth potential to 8 MW; its Berlin 2 page now markets carrier- and cloud-neutral colocation.

name: maincubes BER01 GoWest Berlin
notes: Official maincubes page lists BER01 in Berlin on the GoWest campus as in operation, with 9 MW IT capacity and 55,000 sq ft whitespace.

name: nLighten Berlin edge data center
notes: Official nLighten location page lists its Berlin edge data center with 3,894 sq m dedicated colocation space and 1,800 kW of power.

name: Rechenzentrum Seefeld, Werneuchen
notes: City of Werneuchen public notice says the Satzungsbeschluss made the Bebauungsplan 'Rechenzentrum Seefeld' effective; MOZ reported the bylaw decision and uncertainty around start timing.

name: Rechenzentrum Eiche, Ahrensfelde
notes: Ahrensfelde municipal planning portal identifies the Bebauungsplan 'Rechenzentrum Eiche' east of Eiche at Mehrower Weg on former greenhouse land; local reporting describes an investor plan for a high-tech data center.

name: Britz / Eberswalde Gewerbegebiet data center plan
notes: MOZ reported an investor wants to build four data centers in the Britz industrial area near Eberswalde; later reporting noted interest from companies from Italy and the US.

name: Med Areal Cottbus geothermal data center concept
notes: Official Med Areal page markets a Cottbus data center solution using geothermal energy, photovoltaics and passive-house technology; no MW capacity or construction milestone found.

name: Vantage Berlin II Data Center Campus, Mittenwalde
notes: Official Vantage page gives campus address at Dahmestrasse 1 and 2, 15749 Mittenwalde. DataCenterMap describes two buildings at the Berlin II campus with 16 MW each; treated as 32 MW because the official page was accessible but capacity text was not exposed in search snippet.

name: Google Berlin-Brandenburg / Mittenwalde data center site
notes: Google abandoned plans for a data center near Schenkendorf/Mittenwalde in Dahme-Spreewald after previously buying a 30-hectare site.

name: AWS European Sovereign Cloud data center, Massen-Niederlausitz / Finsterwalde
notes: Elbe-Elster county welcomed AWS locating a central part of the European Sovereign Cloud in Massen; DataCenter-Insider reported earthworks and a container village visible at the Massen industrial park near Finsterwalde; Amazon announced EUR 7.8B for the first sovereign region in Brandenburg.

name: Frankfurt DATA FFO AI hyperscale campus, Markendorf
notes: Trade press reported a hyperscale data center planned in the Markendorf industrial zone in Frankfurt (Oder), with investment near EUR 3.5B and dependent on a 380-kV grid connection. Capacity is reported as 330 MW by DataCenter-Insider; DCD headline says 360 MW.

name: VIRTUS Wustermark Campus
notes: Official VIRTUS page describes the Wustermark campus as up to nine data centers delivering 204 MW IT load; DCD reported construction began in April 2026 with EUR 3B investment.

name: maincubes BER02 / mainHub Berlin Campus, Nauen
notes: Official maincubes pages place BER02/mainHub in Nauen, with up to 144-186 MW IT capacity and a 200 MW grid connection agreement; land purchase completed in 2024, zoning approved, construction scheduled from 2025 with first data center expected by end-2027.

name: NTT Berlin 3 Data Center Campus, Brieselang
developer: NTT Global Data Centers / NTT DATA
notes: NTT announced a third Berlin campus in Brieselang, 30 km west of Berlin, on a 10.8 ha site with 96 MW critical IT load across two data centers; construction expected to start in 2025.

name: ZAE Projekt GmbH Rechenzentrum, Fredersdorf-Vogelsdorf
notes: rbb24 and MOZ reported ZAE Projekt GmbH plans a data center on an 11.8 ha site at the edge of Fredersdorf-Vogelsdorf between the A10 and B1, facing local opposition; MW capacity not found.

name: Colt DCS Berlin 1 and Berlin 2
notes: Colt official page says it secured land 10 km east of Berlin for Berlin 1 and 2, two Tier 3-spec hyperscale data centers delivering 54 MW IT load. Division assignment is based on east-of-Berlin Brandenburg location; exact municipality was not found in the accessible sources.
